run_preprocess_k400_data: run preprocess_k400_data to extract visual features from Kinetics-400 videos and save to HDF5
run_preprocess_k400_data_batch: run _preprocess_k400_data to extract features for a batch of video path and label pairs
review_preprocess_k400_data: review preprocess_k400_data to understand SLURM-based distributed feature extraction and metadata saving logic
refactor_preprocess_k400_data: refactor preprocess_k400_data to support local execution instead of only SLURM-based distributed processing
